subject: A latent variable implementation by a MIMIC (Multiple Indicator Multiple Cause)

messages.subject: A latent variable implementation by a MIMIC (Multiple Indicator Multiple Cause)
parts:
Hi,

 I'm working on Discrete Choice Model field, and I'm using a Mixed Logit Logit in R with the "mlogit" package: http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/mlogit/mlogit.pdf

 Now, I want to implement a latent variable by a hybrid model: MIMIC. I think "lavaan" package is the best solution, but:

 Anyone has any ideas or examples of using "mlogit" and "lavaan" packages to run an MIMIC model??

 Thanks,

 Comendador
